layout_and_composition.overall_feel: Futuristic, clean, and modern with a focus on technology
layout_and_composition.asymmetry: Use of asymmetrical elements to create visual interest (e.g., floating shapes, diagonal lines)
layout_and_composition.whitespace: Ample whitespace to improve readability and create a premium feel

main_image.description: High-quality, black and white image of a person wearing a VR headset, with a glowing purple geometric shape above their head.
main_image.placement: Prominently featured on the homepage, possibly on the left side, enclosed within a circle or other unique shape

geometric_shapes.description: Abstract, glowing purple shapes and lines used as decorative elements to add a futuristic touch.

grid_pattern.description: Subtle, wireframe-like grid pattern in the background or on the bottom of sections to reinforce the tech theme.

buttons.style: Minimalist with a thin border and bold text

navigation.style: Simple, uppercase text links in the header

social_icons.style: Monochrome icons with a simple, modern design

website_sections.name: Home
website_sections.content: A hero section with a bold headline, a concise description of the programmer's expertise, and a call-to-action button (e.g., 'View Portfolio' or 'Contact Me').

website_sections.name: About
website_sections.content: A section with a short bio, skills (listed with icons or progress bars), and a more detailed explanation of the programmer's background and philosophy.

website_sections.name: Portfolio
website_sections.content: A gallery of projects with high-quality screenshots and concise descriptions. Each project should link to a detailed case study page.

website_sections.name: Services
website_sections.content: A list of services offered (e.g., 'Web Development,' 'Mobile Apps,' 'UI/UX Design') with brief descriptions and pricing (if applicable).

website_sections.name: Contact
website_sections.content: A contact form with fields for name, email, subject, and message. Include social media links and an email address for direct contact.
